svg.title: What the framework takes, and what you keep
svg.desc: A hand-drawn side-by-side comparison of the same nine agent-loop responsibilities. The left column, headed from scratch at 187 lines, shows all nine as plain boxes. The right column, headed Pydantic AI at 61 lines, shows seven of them hachured blue under a bracket labelled the framework owns this, while two remain yours and are outlined green: your tool functions and your output model. A red arrow points into the shaded region labelled 'you cannot see the exact bytes in here'. Underneath, six integration tests taking 214 seconds and $0.42 are struck through beside 34 tests in 1.9 seconds for nothing, and structured-output success rises from 89 to 98.5 percent with a validator retry.
svg.text: What the framework takes, and what you keep
you cannot test what you cannot run offline
with a validator retry, for +7% tokens
...so which nine lines do you still own?
